questions.en: Simplify: [sin A × cos(90° - A)] / [cot(90° + A) × cos(180° + A)]
questions.hi: सरल कीजिए: [sin A × cos(90° - A)] / [cot(90° + A) × cos(180° + A)]
questions.sol:
cos(90° - A) = sin A, cot(90° + A) = -tan A, cos(180° + A) = -cos A
व्यंजक = (sin A × sin A) / (-tan A × -cos A) = sin² A / (tan A × cos A)
= sin² A / ((sin A / cos A) × cos A) = sin² A / sin A = sin A.
questions.trick: पूरक कोणों के त्रिकोणमितीय अनुपातों का उपयोग करें।
यदि a + b + c = 0, तो a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc.
